purpose: Qualify one fixed E/F/S fine-tuning contract without opening any final development or prospective environment outcome.

label_contract.rationale: The environments contain OMat24 energy, force, and stress labels. Energy is excluded because cross-release energy-reference compatibility remains unresolved; force and stress use the same contract as the completed pre-training measurement sweep. Phonons are held-out physical outcomes, not training labels.

qualification_grid.selection_rule: Choose the largest learning rate whose loss, gradient norm, parameters, and reloaded checkpoint remain finite and whose held-out E/F/S validation loss does not exceed the starting checkpoint. Break ties by lower validation loss.

proposed_claim_training_after_qualificat.matched_budget: Each final environment contains exactly 50000 atoms and 2100000 Nequix neighbor edges per pass.
proposed_claim_training_after_qualificat.prospective_boundary: Train and score the 12 development environments first, fit the frozen predictor and regression-risk model, serialize predictions for the four prospective environments, and only then train or inspect those four outcomes.

implementation.execution_layout: one visible B200 per training trajectory
implementation.notes: The patch exposes the existing data-loader seed and writes one model and resumable state per epoch. It does not change the loss or optimizer implementation.
